thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 29 at 9:33AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
At 930 AM CDT...Scattered thunderstorms were located mainly across
much of the open Alabama waters from 10 to 60 nm offshore and were
typically moving southwest at 20 knots. Waterspouts will be possible
with these storms along with wind gusts up to 30 knots... locally
higher waves...and heavy downpours. Boaters should consider seeking
safe harbor until this storm has passed.

Weather conditions support the development of waterspouts.
Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally hazardous
waves and seas. If a waterspout is sighted...seek safe harbor
immediately.
properties.area: Coastal waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS out 20 NM; Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 29 at 8:30AM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 830 AM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 13
miles southwest of Clive, or 29 miles northwest of Dugway English
Village, moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Delle, Clive, Utah Test and Training Range South, Skull Valley, and
Dugway Proving Ground Test Range.

This includes Interstate 80 in Utah between mile markers 47 and 77.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
properties.area: Great Salt Lake Desert and Mountains; Tooele and Rush Valleys

properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 29 at 7:25AM PDT until August 29 at 8:00AM PDT by NWS Elko NV
properties.description:
SVRLKN

The National Weather Service in Elko Nevada has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern White Pine County in northeastern Nevada...

* Until 800 AM PDT.

of Ibapah, or 29 miles east of Schellbourne, moving east at 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage

northeastern White Pine County.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 29 at 10:05AM EDT until August 29 at 11:30AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1130 AM EDT.

* At 1005 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 15 nm southeast of Buckeye Reef. The severe
thunderstorm was nearly stationary.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats...damage
vessels...and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34
knots...suddenly higher waves...frequent lightning...and
heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM; Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Illinois...

Illinois River at Beardstown affecting Morgan, Brown, Cass and
Schuyler Counties.

moisture conditions, and forecast precipitation.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Illinois River at Beardstown.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* IMPACTS...At 14.0 feet, Minor flooding begins to agricultural areas
not protected by levees.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 5:45 AM CDT Saturday was 14.9 feet.

afternoon and continue falling to 11.4 feet Friday evening.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 28 at 8:36PM CDT until August 30 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Indiana...Illinois...

Wabash River from Hutsonville to Vincennes.

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River from Hutsonville down
to Vincennes. The river has crested. Flooding should come to an end
on the Wabash over the weekend.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Vincennes.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 18.0 feet, Agricultural lands and some oil fields
flood.  Several township roads about 1.25 miles south of St.
Francesville and River Road between Billett Road and Lincoln
Memorial Bridge in Lawrence County are flooded.  Extensive flooding
of Kimmell Park at Vincennes.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 PM CDT /8:45 PM EDT/ Friday the stage was 17.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:45 PM CDT /8:45 PM EDT/ Friday was 18.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
tomorrow evening and continue falling to 4.5 feet Monday,
September 07.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 17.7
feet on 06/12/1980.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Flooding is occurring. Most flood related deaths occur in
automobiles. Do not attempt to cross water covered bridges, dips, or
low water crossings. Never try to cross a flowing stream, even a
small one, on foot. To escape rising water find another route over
higher ground.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued Saturday morning at 1015 AM CDT
/1115 AM EDT/.
properties.area: Lawrence, IL; Wabash, IL; Knox, IN
